item.title: Back Stage
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TJR
  • 発売日: 2008-08-08
  • スコア: 7.44/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: BackStage -バックステージ-
  • 英語名: Back Stage

あらすじ

Mitsuaki wants to be an actor. One day, he joins a theatrical group called “Back Set”. The boss of the group is Kyouka, a stage director, and she is a little bit odd. Members come and go…

“It’s hard to lead the group…” She tries her hardest to gather members and somehow makes manages to reel in a voice actress, an idol singer, and a dancer. Kyouka says to Mitsuaki, “Mitsuaki, I want you to be a cast leader. Well, take care of other members.” He is surprised to hear that, but he does his best…
